rightsNote: Curated kit titles, series, grade, scale and release months from published Bandai Hobby product/manual listings. Original editorial summaries and lore. The initial 15 catalog records and IDs are preserved. Blank model codes indicate not yet independently confirmed; barcodes and image fields are intentionally blank pending verification and usage rights. Release months are for the listed kit edition, not for the in-fiction mobile suit.

kits.name: God Gundam
kits.notes:
MOBILE SUIT BACKGROUND
In Mobile Fighter G Gundam, Domon Kasshu pilots this Neo Japan machine in the 13th Gundam Fight. Built as the successor to Shining Gundam, it excels at martial-arts combat. Its Hyper Mode opens distinctive sections around the chest and deploys its back wings, while the devastating God Finger is its best-known finishing attack.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
This RG kit translates God Gundam’s athletic silhouette into a small-scale display piece designed for expressive fighting poses. The chest unit, shoulder structure and leg articulation make its signature close-combat stance the focus. Its appearance differs from the older HG and MG interpretations, making this a distinct catalog entry.
kits.summary: An action-focused Real Grade rendition of the martial-arts mobile suit from Mobile Fighter G Gundam.
kits.lore: In Mobile Fighter G Gundam, Domon Kasshu pilots this Neo Japan machine in the 13th Gundam Fight. Built as the successor to Shining Gundam, it excels at martial-arts combat. Its Hyper Mode opens distinctive sections around the chest and deploys its back wings, while the devastating God Finger is its best-known finishing attack.

kits.name: Gundam Barbatos
kits.notes:
MOBILE SUIT BACKGROUND
Gundam Barbatos is an ancient Gundam Frame originally created during the Calamity War in the Iron-Blooded Orphans timeline. Centuries later, Mikazuki Augus takes control of it for Tekkadan. Its twin Ahab reactors, Alaya-Vijnana interface and preference for crushing melee weapons make it a fearsome close-range machine. Its armor and equipment change as the story progresses.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The MG interpretation emphasizes an exposed internal Gundam Frame beneath the white armor, bringing its mechanical structure into focus. The design combines slender limbs, layered armor and heavy melee equipment for the rugged aesthetic of Iron-Blooded Orphans. This catalog entry refers specifically to the 2019 MG, not the similarly named HG or MGSD kits.
kits.summary: A 1/100 Master Grade build centered on Barbatos’s visible Gundam Frame and distinctive mechanical proportions.
kits.lore: Gundam Barbatos is an ancient Gundam Frame originally created during the Calamity War in the Iron-Blooded Orphans timeline. kits.name: Gundam Calibarn
kits.series: Mobile Suit Gundam: The Witch from Mercury
kits.notes:
MOBILE SUIT BACKGROUND
Developed by Ochs Earth and the Vanadis Institute, Gundam Calibarn is an experimental prototype from the early days of GUND-ARM research. Its design put exceptional performance ahead of pilot safety, so it lost out to Gundam Lfrith and was hidden away. Suletta Mercury eventually pilots the machine in the final stages of The Witch from Mercury. Calibarn is recognizable by its white armor and long Variable Rod Rifle, which includes its own propulsion system.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
Gundam Calibarn’s 1/144 High Grade kit features a largely white armored silhouette with colorful shell-unit details. Its long Variable Rod Rifle is a defining accessory, while its GUND-BIT-related equipment provides additional display possibilities. This is the standard 2023 HG release rather than a later special-color edition.
kits.summary: The sleek white HG mobile suit from The Witch from Mercury, known for its long Variable Rod Rifle.

kits.name: Gundam Schwarzette
kits.series: Mobile Suit Gundam: The Witch from Mercury
kits.notes:
MOBILE SUIT BACKGROUND
Developed by Jeturk Heavy Machinery and later equipped with GUND technology, Schwarzette appears in The Witch from Mercury under pilot Lauda Neill. Its signature Guardian weapon combines a large blade with detachable Bit Staves that can be arranged for attack or defense. The result is a compact but imposing Gundam centered on an unusual modular weapon system.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
Gundam Schwarzette stands apart through its broad blade, sharp armor shapes and asymmetrical visual emphasis. The Guardian multipurpose offense-and-defense platform can be arranged in different configurations and mounted on the model’s back. The kit combines an imposing silhouette with compact HG engineering.
kits.summary: A dark, angular High Grade Gundam with a reconfigurable Guardian weapon system.

kits.name: Gundam Barbatos
kits.notes:
MOBILE SUIT BACKGROUND
In Iron-Blooded Orphans, Barbatos is a surviving machine from the Calamity War, revived to fight alongside the young soldiers of Tekkadan. Mikazuki Augus controls it through the Alaya-Vijnana system, using heavy weapons and gradually changing armor configurations. The MGSD kit reinterprets that battle-worn design with exaggerated proportions while retaining the recognizable Gundam Frame identity.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The MGSD Barbatos compresses the Gundam Frame aesthetic into a super-deformed silhouette without discarding its layered construction. Articulated head, torso and arms support dynamic poses, with frame details and moving cylinders adding depth beneath the armor. MGSD kits do not use a conventional numerical scale.
kits.summary: Barbatos reimagined in Master Grade SD form, pairing stylized proportions with mechanical detail.
kits.lore: In Iron-Blooded Orphans, Barbatos is a surviving machine from the Calamity War, revived to fight alongside the young soldiers of Tekkadan. The MGSD kit reinterprets that battle-worn design with exaggerated proportions while retaining the recognizable Gundam Frame identity.

kits.name: Freedom Gundam
kits.notes:
MOBILE SUIT BACKGROUND
Freedom Gundam is the powerful, winged mobile suit associated with Kira Yamato in Mobile Suit Gundam SEED. Known for its advanced mobility and formidable beam and railgun armament, it can engage several targets in rapid succession. The MGSD version gives the familiar blue-and-white armor, spread wings and heavy firepower a compact, highly stylized form.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
MGSD Freedom Gundam combines a compact body with its recognizable blue-and-black wing binders. Its stylized shape incorporates articulated joints and layered mechanical surfaces that distinguish MGSD from standard SD kits. This entry is separate from the full-size MG and RG Freedom Gundam releases.
kits.summary: A high-detail, non-scale SD interpretation of Freedom Gundam from Mobile Suit Gundam SEED.
kits.lore: Freedom Gundam is the powerful, winged mobile suit associated with Kira Yamato in Mobile Suit Gundam SEED. Known for its advanced mobility and formidable beam and railgun armament, it can engage several targets in rapid succession. The MGSD version gives the familiar blue-and-white armor, spread wings and heavy firepower a compact, highly stylized form.

kits.name: Wing Gundam Zero EW
kits.series: Mobile Suit Gundam Wing: Endless Waltz
kits.notes:
MOBILE SUIT BACKGROUND
The Endless Waltz interpretation of Wing Zero is associated with Heero Yuy and its iconic feather-like wing binders. Behind the elegant appearance is the formidable ZERO System, which provides the pilot with predictive combat data. Its Twin Buster Rifle is the centerpiece of its ranged firepower; the MGSD design adapts that imposing silhouette into a compact display model.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
This MGSD release emphasizes Wing Zero’s dramatic wing silhouette with multi-layered, articulated binders. Its wing panels open to expose internal silver and clear details, and the design supports Neo Bird-style configurations. The Twin Buster Rifle adds a focal point for display and posing.
kits.summary: A premium MGSD Wing Zero EW with elaborate feathered binders and transformation features.

kits.name: RX-78-2 Gundam
kits.notes:
MOBILE SUIT BACKGROUND
The RX-78-2 is the iconic Earth Federation mobile suit from the original Mobile Suit Gundam. Amuro Ray pilots it during the One Year War, where its beam rifle, beam sabers, shield and other advanced equipment establish it as a formidable prototype. Perfect Grade Unleashed treats this famous machine as an engineering showcase, with extensive mechanical layers beneath its familiar tricolor armor.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
Perfect Grade Unleashed presents the classic RX-78-2 as a large, detailed engineering showcase. Its multi-stage assembly builds up the internal mechanical structure before completing the exterior armor, emphasizing layers of frame, detail and finishing. The design is a different product from the conventional Perfect Grade RX-78-2.
kits.summary: The landmark 1/60 Perfect Grade Unleashed interpretation of the original RX-78-2 Gundam.
kits.lore: The RX-78-2 is the iconic Earth Federation mobile suit from the original Mobile Suit Gundam. Amuro Ray pilots it during the One Year War, where its beam rifle, beam sabers, shield and other advanced equipment establish it as a formidable prototype. Perfect Grade Unleashed treats this famous machine as an engineering showcase, with extensive mechanical layers beneath its familiar tricolor armor.

kits.name: Strike Freedom Gundam
kits.notes:
MOBILE SUIT BACKGROUND
Strike Freedom is Kira Yamato’s advanced successor to Freedom Gundam in Mobile Suit Gundam SEED Destiny. Designed for high-speed combat and simultaneous attacks against many targets, it carries remote-controlled Super DRAGOON units, powerful beam weapons and beam shields. The MGEX release highlights its distinctive gold internal structure as a major part of the building and display experience.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The MGEX Strike Freedom Gundam places its gold inner frame at the center of the build, using multiple metallic finishes and etched details to create depth. Linked movements between the frame and armor support expressive posing, while the wing-mounted DRAGOON equipment shapes its expansive silhouette. This entry is for the 2022 MGEX release, not the standard MG or RG versions.
kits.summary: A flagship MGEX release focused on Strike Freedom’s striking metallic-gold internal frame.
kits.lore: Strike Freedom is Kira Yamato’s advanced successor to Freedom Gundam in Mobile Suit Gundam SEED Destiny. Designed for high-speed combat and simultaneous attacks against many targets, it carries remote-controlled Super DRAGOON units, powerful beam weapons and beam shields. The MGEX release highlights its distinctive gold internal structure as a major part of the building and display experience.

kits.name: Sazabi
kits.notes:
MOBILE SUIT BACKGROUND
Char Aznable pilots this red, heavy-duty mobile suit in Char’s Counterattack as the central rival to Amuro Ray’s ν Gundam. Despite its considerable size, Sazabi combines powerful thrusters with agile movement. Its psycho-frame-equipped cockpit and remotely controlled funnels reflect Char’s Newtype abilities, while its large armor plates and distinctive head define its appearance.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
RG Sazabi captures the mobile suit’s massive armor shapes at 1/144 scale, with prominent shoulder, chest and leg surfaces and a distinctive backpack. The layered armor and articulated structure contrast with the kit’s bulky silhouette. It is a separate release from the larger MG Sazabi Ver.Ka.
kits.summary: A dense, highly detailed Real Grade version of Char Aznable’s heavy red mobile suit.
kits.lore: Char Aznable pilots this red, heavy-duty mobile suit in Char’s Counterattack as the central rival to Amuro Ray’s ν Gundam. kits.name: Hi-Nu Gundam
kits.series: Mobile Suit Gundam: Char's Counterattack – Beltorchika's Children
kits.notes:
MOBILE SUIT BACKGROUND
Associated with Amuro Ray and the Beltorchika’s Children interpretation of the Char’s Counterattack story, Hi-ν Gundam is a refined Newtype-use machine. Its large wing-like array of six Fin Funnels provides remote attack and defensive options, supported by a sophisticated psycho-frame and conventional weaponry. The Real Grade kit emphasizes its distinctive blue-and-white armor and elaborate backpack.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The RG Hi-ν Gundam emphasizes a sleek blue-and-white silhouette with a substantial fin-funnel backpack. Detailed surface separation and articulated joints give the 1/144 model an intricate appearance. This is the standard RG Hi-ν release, distinct from limited metallic and special-finish editions.
kits.summary: A Real Grade Hi-ν Gundam recognizable by its blue-and-white armor and large fin funnels.

kits.name: Gundam Epyon
kits.notes:
MOBILE SUIT BACKGROUND
Treize Khushrenada creates Gundam Epyon in Mobile Suit Gundam Wing as a machine devoted to honorable close-range duels. Piloted by both Heero Yuy and Zechs Merquise, it relies on a powerful beam sword and a whip-like heat rod instead of conventional long-range weapons. Its dragon-like mobile armor mode and Epyon System reinforce its distinctive combat philosophy.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The 2023 RG Gundam Epyon pairs the mobile suit’s angular red armor with articulated wing and torso mechanisms. Its design allows both humanoid sword-fighting poses and a two-headed flight configuration. The beam sword and heat rod are key visual elements of Epyon’s close-combat identity.
kits.summary: A Real Grade Epyon designed for powerful sword poses and its signature flight transformation.

kits.name: Gundam Barbatos
kits.notes:
MOBILE SUIT BACKGROUND
Barbatos begins Iron-Blooded Orphans as an old Calamity War machine repurposed to power a base on Mars. Mikazuki Augus reactivates it, and Tekkadan repeatedly repairs and re-equips it as their battles escalate. Its exposed inner frame, mismatched early armor and oversized melee weapons are central to the mobile suit’s identity, reproduced here in approachable High Grade form.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The early HG Barbatos release reproduces the mobile suit’s exposed frame look, compact shoulder armor and heavy melee stance in a straightforward build. Its 1/144 proportions and simpler construction differentiate it from the larger 2019 Master Grade. It is a useful entry point for collecting multiple Barbatos variations.
kits.summary: An accessible 1/144 HG interpretation of the original Gundam Barbatos from Iron-Blooded Orphans.

kits.name: Gundam Aerial
kits.series: Mobile Suit Gundam: The Witch from Mercury
kits.notes:
MOBILE SUIT BACKGROUND
Gundam Aerial is Suletta Mercury’s personal mobile suit in The Witch from Mercury. Developed by Shin Sei, it uses GUND technology and an array of remotely controlled GUND-BITs that can also combine into the Escutcheon shield. The original High Grade kit represents the first Aerial design, before the later Rebuild version changes its silhouette and equipment.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The standard HG Aerial uses clean rounded armor shapes, prominent chest details and a recognizable blue-and-white color scheme. Its shield is made from GUND-BIT equipment, giving the design a modular visual identity. This listing describes the original Aerial rather than the Aerial Rebuild or other variants.
kits.summary: A compact High Grade Gundam Aerial from The Witch from Mercury, featuring its distinctive shield system.

kits.name: Gundam Vidar
kits.notes:
MOBILE SUIT BACKGROUND
In the second season of Iron-Blooded Orphans, Gundam Vidar is a masked machine associated with Gaelio Bauduin and Gjallarhorn. It favors swift assault tactics, combining handguns with its Burst Saber and built-in Hunter’s Edge weapons. Its specialized Alaya-Vijnana Type E equipment and concealed identity are important to the mobile suit’s story.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
MG Gundam Vidar uses a revised Gundam Frame that expands shoulder movement and introduces linked motion around the knee armor. Small moving mechanisms include deployable Hunter Edges and a handgun action feature. The kit’s weapon-focused presentation includes a rifle, two handguns and Burst Saber equipment.
kits.summary: A 1/100 Master Grade Vidar featuring an updated Gundam Frame and multiple weapon options.

kits.notes:
MOBILE SUIT BACKGROUND
Amuro Ray pilots the Earth Federation’s prototype mobile suit during the One Year War. The RX-78-2 becomes the defining symbol of the original Gundam story.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The 2015 HGUC Revive edition offers a clean, modernized interpretation of the original RX-78-2. It is a separate release from both the Beyond Global and Entry Grade versions.

The RX-78-2 is the prototype Gundam entrusted to Amuro Ray in the Federation–Zeon conflict. Its recognizable silhouette has inspired many later designs.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The Beyond Global release revisits the familiar suit with noticeably different proportions and posing-oriented construction. This is not the 2015 HGUC Revive kit.
